_doc: Bowman first job (#166/#199). Ranks match every canonical v83 level; canonical prerequisites ignored (tier C, owner #31). Double Shot uses bow_double_shot because Pirate owns double_shot. Soul Arrow 3101004/3201004 is never added: endless ammo makes it redundant (owner #166). Hunter and Crossbowman append their entries here in that order.

blessing_of_amazon.name: The Blessing of Amazon
blessing_of_amazon.desc: Increases accuracy, which also raises critical chance.

critical_shot.name: Critical Shot
critical_shot.desc: Increases critical chance and critical damage with bows and crossbows.
critical_shot._tier: Tier A: canonical prop/damage and 20 levels. Tier C: bow/crossbow family tag; tier B: additive critical damage (shared physical passive).

eye_of_amazon.name: The Eye of Amazon
eye_of_amazon._tier: Tier A: canonical range +15 to +120, eight levels. Tier C: bow/crossbow family tag and range interpreted as additive pixels to ranged basic reach and family-gated attack-skill range; no effect on melee or Magician skills.

focus.name: Focus
focus._tier: Tier A: canonical mpCon, time, acc (including string values), eva, action, art and sound. Tier C: self-only auto-cast, recast on expiry, 0.8s hold.

arrow_blow.name: Arrow Blow
arrow_blow.desc: Fires a powerful arrow at the nearest monster.
arrow_blow._tier: Tier A: canonical mpCon, damage, bulletCount (Double Shot), hit art and Arrow Blow Use sound. Tier C: bow/crossbow tag, nearest targeting, 1s cooldown, 300px base range (no WZ range), 600px/s speed, 8px radius, no base pierce, 0.6s hold and held weapon shooting stance. Current arrow sprite replaces skill ball. Double Shot splits over targets like Pirate Double Shot and reuses Arrow Blow Use sound because Sound.wz has no3001005 node; neither skill has a Hit sound. Untuned.

bow_double_shot.name: Double Shot
bow_double_shot.desc: Fires two arrows at nearby monsters.
bow_double_shot._tier: Tier A: canonical mpCon, damage, bulletCount (Double Shot), hit art and Arrow Blow Use sound. Tier C: bow/crossbow tag, nearest targeting, 1s cooldown, 300px base range (no WZ range), 600px/s speed, 8px radius, no base pierce, 0.6s hold and held weapon shooting stance. Current arrow sprite replaces skill ball. Double Shot splits over targets like Pirate Double Shot and reuses Arrow Blow Use sound because Sound.wz has no3001005 node; neither skill has a Hit sound. Untuned.
